## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behaviour and linked issue (if any).

## Validation

Explain what you tested, including relevant OS/display and screenshots for UI changes.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes.
- [ ] Changes to isolation, reset, IPC, navigation or persistence include regression coverage.
- [ ] Packaging changes were tested on the target OS with the sandbox enabled.
- [ ] No credentials, profiles or private data are included.

Mention limitations or remaining platform checks.
